[Report] Technology in Adventure Travel Chances are, travelers looking to book the once-in-a-lifetime experiences you provide aren’t stuffing a Discman into their carry-on and a phone card into their wallets as they plan and pack for their trips. So why are so many in the industry still relying on the technology we had in the 90’s to deliver today’s travel experiences?
ATTA’s report, “ Creating, Communicating and Connecting: Technology in Adventure Travel,” shows that legacy technology dominates many of the landscapes of today’s travel providers – but it doesn’t have to.
